bio.text: Kelly Esti, a Navy veteran with a PhD in public policy, was one of two Democrats in the May 19, 2026 primary for Georgia's 8th Congressional District, according to an April 2026 WALB report.
According to that report, he studied nuclear power in the Navy and later earned a PhD in public policy.
The report says he grew up in Magnolia, Mississippi, served on the Fulton County zoning board and was involved in creating the city of South Fulton.

sources.title: Two Democrats vie for chance to challenge Austin Scott in Georgia's 8th Congressional District
